description: Plain Django view (no auth, no throttle, `Cache-Control: no-cache` via `never_cache`) polled by the VM cron and the deploy script. summary: Sign in with e-mail and password
description: Verifies the credentials and opens a session; returns an RS256 **access** token (15 min, send as `Authorization: Bearer <access>`) and a **refresh** token (rotated on every use; session lasts at most `ACCOUNTS_SESSION_MAX_AGE`, 30 days). Both travel in the JSON body — no cookies. Errors: 401 `invalid_credentials` (wrong e-mail/password, unknown or inactive user — indistinguishable), 403 `password_reset_required` (correct password but the account must set one via the reset/invite link), 429 `login_locked` with `Retry-After` (too many failures per e-mail or IP), 429 throttled. The test script stores `access` → `{{access_token}}` and `refresh` → `{{refresh_token}}`.

auth.notes: Anonymous: ignores any Authorization header. Throttle scope `login` (10/15min per client IP).

description: Ends the session the refresh token belongs to and blacklists that token (refresh token in the JSON body, not a cookie). auth.notes: Anonymous; refresh token in the JSON body. Throttle scope `token_refresh`.

description: Exchanges the refresh token (JSON body field `refresh`, not a cookie) for a new access + refresh pair; the presented refresh token is blacklisted. description: Multipart upload; the type is sniffed from the content (not the extension). Limits: IMAGE/PHOTO jpeg, png, webp, heic ≤ 15 MB; DOCUMENT pdf ≤ 20 MB; RESUME pdf/doc/docx ≤ 10 MB and SIGNATURE png ≤ 2 MB (both PRIVATE only → 400 `visibility_not_allowed`). GPS/location metadata is stripped from public images. `folder` is a lowercase path (`projects/thrissur`); reserved folders → 400 `folder_reserved`. Errors: 400 `empty_file`, `unsupported_file_type`, `image_too_large` (pixels), 413 `file_too_large`, 503 `storage_unavailable`. Pick a local file for `file` before sending. Captures `uid` into `{{media_uid}}` (and `{{media_upload_uid}}`) and, on the local dev backend, the storage key into `{{dev_media_path}}`. The variant uploads a PRIVATE pdf for the signed-URL flow.
